summary: Perf fix round: all 7 review findings confirmed and fixed with regression tests. (1) Keyword sorts with a custom missing value: natives are ordinals x ORD_SCALE (4); a missing term the segment lacks takes the middle of its gap, and foreign values in that gap sort around it by bytes, so orders match ES 9.5.5 (also for fieldless segments). (7) TopFieldCollector queue entries keep natives plus a segment generation, are translated once per segment, and reuse the evicted entry's buffers. geonames keyword sorts of 1000 hits went from 41-71 ms to 21-24 ms with identical hits. (2) Numbers indexed as keyword/text, in multi-fields and in copy_to keep their text as written, on both the general and the bulk fast path; a one-pass span map in XParser::raw_text avoids quadratic re-scans. (3) ignore_above counts UTF-16 units everywhere. (4) unmapped_type sorts honour missing per type and give ES's errors for text and scaled_float. (5) rolld starts the purge governor. (6) contracts.md now allows getrusage. YAML ES 3809/3905 and OS 1455/1506, 0 regressions.
public_api: No signature change in contracts.md-documented APIs. search-index: TopFieldCollector behaviour only (keyword missing values exact across segments; no per-probe allocation). search-es internals: crate::document::exceeds_ignore_above(s: &str, limit: usize) -> bool (pub(crate), Java String.length semantics); crate::json::locate::number_spans(src, &Value) -> Option<HashMap<usize,(usize,usize)>> (pub); XParser gains pub field raw_number: Option<String> (original text of a scalar number root) and raw_text() is O(1) amortized for documents; document::values::{raw_number_of, parse_detached_raw} (pub(crate)). rolld main calls search_server::process::start_purge_governor.
done: Finding 1 (keyword missing across segments), CONFIRMED+FIXED: crates/search-index/src/collector/top_field.rs. Added ORD_SCALE=4; LeafKey.missing_term holds the insertion point and bytes of a custom missing term the segment lacks. to_native places foreign terms at mid-1/mid/mid+1 of the gap by comparing bytes with it. Pruner::update_terms rescaled (floor/ceil). Tests: sort_pruning.rs keyword_missing_values_order_like_elasticsearch (ES 9.5.5 orders from the reviewer's repro plus fieldless segments, at thresholds MAX/0/3) and keyword_sorts_with_missing_values_match_brute_force (8 seeds x 80 rounds against a brute-force model: missing first/last/value, min/max, both directions, _doc second key, search_after, concurrent). Mutation-checked: disabling the byte ordering fails both.

Finding 7 (insert allocations), CONFIRMED+FIXED: Entry now has natives plus a generation; TopFieldCollector.generation is bumped per leaf. translate() re-derives an entry's natives in place once per segment. insert() pops the evicted entry and reuses its Vec<SortValue> and Bytes (fill_values/value_into). refresh_bottom uses clone_from with no natives_of. A competitive doc in a full queue now costs no heap allocation and at most one dictionary lookup per entry per segment. Release A/B on geonames 1.1M (r9c vs r10a, pinned to 8 threads, median of 15, 2 rounds): name.raw size 1000 53-71 -> 21-24 ms; desc + tth 46-55 -> 20-29; cc2.raw missing M 41-44 -> 21-22; search_after 58-69 -> 22-24; country_code.raw + population size 100 6.8-7.0 -> 5.1-5.7. Hits identical (md5).

Finding 2 (numbers as written), CONFIRMED+FIXED: ES indexes the JSON text as written for main fields, multi-fields and copy_to (verified on ES 9.5.5). search-es json/locate.rs number_spans walks the body and the tree once. XParser::raw_text uses that map (built lazily) and checks that the text still parses to the value (pipelines), falling back to the path locate or the rendering. values.rs text_of uses raw text for numbers that can differ (Float, Int(0), Big). document/mod.rs passes the walker's raw text to multi-field and copy_to parses (parse_detached_raw). fast.rs Tok::text returns raw; the detached distinction is gone (date multi-fields read raw too, as in the general path).

Finding 3 (ignore_above UTF-16), CONFIRMED+FIXED: document::exceeds_ignore_above (a byte-length shortcut, then encode_utf16 count) used in values.rs, fast.rs, engine/convert.rs (keyword + flattened), search/fields.rs (keyword + flattened leaves), search/highlight.rs and engine/synthetic.rs.

Tests for 2+3: src/document/fast/tests.rs numbers_index_as_written_like_elasticsearch (ES 9.5.5 terms keys for kk/t/t.raw/d.k/ck/l.k, _ignored with the emoji value, both paths); random_documents_agree gets number forms 1.10, 1E5, 1.5E+3, 10000000.0, 12345678.9 and -0e0.

Finding 4 (unmapped_type ignores missing), CONFIRMED+FIXED: search/sort.rs unmapped_key builds the key per type (Int/Double/Float/HalfFloat/Long, with boolean numeric, else Keyword) with numeric_missing/keyword_missing, and date_nanos _first/_last 0/MAX. text gives the fielddata-disabled error on [__anonymous_], scaled_float gives 'Field [scaling_factor] is required'. numeric_missing now takes a Kind. 21 probe queries match ES exactly.

REST fixture crates/search-es/tests/fixtures/rest/perf_sort_text.json: 52 steps captured from a private ES 9.5.5 (roll-es-perf, since stopped) through the capture harness. Covers keyword missing across segments, unmapped_type sorts and errors, numbers as written via terms aggs for a 1-item bulk (general path) and a 70-item bulk (fast path), and ignore_above with emoji. rest_fixtures passes.

Finding 5 (governor not in rolld), CONFIRMED+FIXED: crates/rolld/src/main.rs builds the runtime, then start_purge_governor(handle, available_parallelism) and block_on. The docs/benchmarks/search.md governor row now says it is started by search-dev and rolld. cargo check and clippy -D warnings on rolld are clean.
Finding 6 (getrusage vs contracts), CONFIRMED+FIXED: the docs/search/contracts.md Allowed dependencies line for search-server libc now names getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF) for the purge governor.
Docs: benchmarks tuning-log row for queue entries and keyword missing slots (r9c vs r10a numbers); compatibility.md Performance gains a sentence on keyword sorts. YAML thresholds unchanged.
Binary target/bench-search/search-dev-r10a (release, this round). Progress log in ~/.cache/roll-search/reports/live/fix-perf.progress.md.
remaining: collector/collapse.rs still calls natives_of (it allocates and does keyword lookups) per group comparison and per bottom refresh. Apply the same per-entry natives plus generation scheme there.

TopFieldCollector's queue is a sorted Vec; insert(pos) memmoves about 64 B x n/2 per competitive doc (n=1000: about 32 KB). A heap can't be used as is, because heap sifts compare two foreign entries, which the 3-slot gap encoding can't order exactly. An ordinal-plus-bytes fallback comparator would allow one.

unmapped_type ip with a missing value fails in ES's fetch phase ('Failed trying to format bytes as IP address'); roll still sorts it as a keyword. unmapped_type unsigned_long missing prints the shifted value in ES (9223372036854775811 for 3); roll's output is not verified.

Carried over from round 3: intra-shard concurrent search (slices when shards < cores) for the geonames script-score gaps; search_after sorts on 45-segment indices; bulk p50 service time; Rally nyc_taxis/pmc/so/noaa subsets; native Graviton numbers.
tests: search-index: all test binaries pass (sort_pruning 8/8 including the 2 new tests); clippy --all-targets -D warnings clean. search-es: lib 457 pass (including fast::tests::numbers_index_as_written_like_elasticsearch) and every integration test binary passes, including rest_fixtures with the new perf_sort_text.json; clippy --all-targets -D warnings clean. rolld: check and clippy -D warnings clean. YAML on r10a (ROLL_PORT=19800, 8 jobs): ES 3809 passed / 1 failed (the pre-existing knn profile test) / 95 skipped of 3905, OS 1455/1506, 0 regressions in both.
notes_for_others: compat-es: XParser::raw_text is now cheap for document bodies (one-pass span map keyed by Value node address, built lazily, only when base is empty). It returns the rendering when the source text no longer parses to the value. parse_detached_raw(w, f, full, v, raw) lets a detached parse of a copied number see its original text (XParser.raw_number).
Anyone checking ignore_above: use crate::document::exceeds_ignore_above(s, limit), which counts Java String.length (UTF-16 units), not chars().count().
TopFieldCollector internals: keyword Native::Ord is ordinal x 4 (ORD_SCALE), not x 2. Code that builds or reads Ord natives (Pruner bounds) must use ORD_SCALE.
rolld now runs search_server::process::start_purge_governor: purge delay 100 ms while the process is busy, 0 plus collect when idle. ROLL_MI_PURGE_DELAY_MS still disables it.

REST fixture capture: I captured perf_sort_text.json against a private ES container, because the capture harness's cleanup deletes every esm-* object on the target cluster. Don't point it at the shared roll-es-ref while others may be capturing.
